Promises = explicit team commitments ('will do/on it/I'll have the team...'); kept = confirmed done in-chat or verified by client silence on a previously flagged-daily issue; lapsed = no evidence of delivery after 7+ days; remainder pending. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive team-side messages (Jul 21-26).
